sources.usedFor: Every control citation. Loci are resolved against reference/loci.json, which is derived from this file.

sources.usedFor: The format of the generated bill of materials. Annex I, Part II, point (1) requires a commonly used machine-readable format and does not name one; SPDX would satisfy it equally.
